title.bn: পথ চেয়ে যে কেটে গেল কত দিনে রাতে
title.translit: Path cheye je kete gelo koto dine raate

provenance.encoding_method: automated parse of the witness's notation grid (tools/parse_nltr.py) + manual review of every line

notes: Archive-derived (v0.2): encoded from the online witness; not yet checked against a printed Swarabitan page.
